question: Which suppliers raised prices after the June contract review, and by how much?

answer.text: Two suppliers raised prices after the review on 18 June. Harbour Paper added 4% to every order from 1 July.
Tamsin Office Goods moved its delivery fee from £12 to £18 on the same date.
Northgate Print kept its prices, but its new contract ends in March instead of December.
None of the three changed their payment terms.
